entries.title: Moonlit Citadel
entries.description: A guild stronghold rises above a sleeping coastal city while violet storms and warm windows divide the night.

media.alt: Moonlit fantasy citadel above a coastal city

entries.title: The Golden Harbor
entries.description: Morning arrives over a fortified port as travelers cross the final bridge toward the city.

media.alt: Golden fantasy harbor at sunrise

entries.title: Lanterns in the Old Grove
entries.description: Ancient roots, ruined stone and luminous moths guide explorers toward a forgotten forest gate.

media.alt: Magical forest ruins with violet lantern moths

entries.title: The Frozen Passage
entries.description: A small expedition follows one distant light through a mountain pass shaped by wind and ice.

media.alt: Adventurers crossing a frozen mountain pass

entries.title: Temple of the Red Beacon
entries.description: A forgotten desert complex wakes beneath a red crystal as three adventurers approach its causeway.

media.alt: Ancient desert temple with a red crystal beacon

entries.title: The Crystal Descent
entries.description: Bridges, waterfalls and luminous crystal lead a guild party toward an ancient underground door.

media.alt: Vast crystal cavern with bridges and waterfalls

entries.title: Vigil Above the City
entries.description: A solitary paladin watches a living city from the wall while aurora light moves over distant towers.

media.alt: Paladin standing watch above a fantasy city

entries.title: Council at the Living Map
entries.description: A knight and druid turn a quiet table into the beginning of the next expedition.

media.alt: Knight and druid planning over a magical map

entries.title: Keeper of the Star Library
entries.description: A mage studies a moving sky of books and constellations inside a library built for impossible questions.

media.alt: Mage studying constellations in a magical library

entries.title: Across the Ancient Bridge
entries.description: Five adventurers cross above a fog-filled abyss with only lantern light and a distant city ahead.

media.alt: Guild party crossing an ancient suspended bridge

entries.title: Before the Dragon Moves
entries.description: An obsidian dragon and a disciplined guild party measure the final silence before battle.

media.alt: Guild party confronting an obsidian dragon

entries.title: Hydra of the Drowned Court
entries.description: Three watchful heads rise among ruined statues while black water reflects a single scout's torch.

media.alt: Three-headed hydra in a moonlit swamp

entries.title: The Moon-Wolf Run
entries.description: Spectral wolves race through the snow as silver fur carries the color of the night sky.

media.alt: Spectral moon wolves racing through snowy ruins

entries.title: Guardian Beneath the Gate
entries.description: A crystal golem awakens above two explorers as its ancient core floods the temple with light.

media.alt: Immense crystal golem awakening in an underground temple

entries.title: The Warlord at Black Gate
entries.description: A fallen commander waits in the rain before a sealed gate as another company finally arrives.

media.alt: Armored fallen warlord before a black gate

entries.title: The Violet Crypt
entries.description: A necromancer calls translucent spirits through a cathedral-sized crypt of candles and stone.

media.alt: Necromancer summoning spirits in a candlelit crypt

entries.title: Leviathan at the Harbor Light
entries.description: A colossal sea creature rises beyond the lighthouse while ships turn toward the city's shelter.

media.alt: Sea leviathan surfacing near a stormy harbor

entries.title: Sentinel of the Broken Nave
entries.description: An ancient guardian remains standing where stained glass and forest light reclaim a ruined cathedral.

media.alt: Ghostly sentinel inside a ruined cathedral

entries.title: After the Hunt
entries.description: Weapons rest beside the fire while a guild party trades food, stories and the quiet relief of returning together.

media.alt: Guild adventurers resting around a campfire

entries.title: Festival of the Red Crystal
entries.description: Adventurers, townsfolk and friendly creatures celebrate together around a luminous monument.

media.alt: Fantasy guild city festival around a red crystal monument

entries.title: The Stormbound Arrival
entries.description: A guild skyship reaches a cliffside citadel while lantern-bearing hosts wait beneath a violet storm.

media.alt: Fantasy skyship approaching a cliffside guild citadel in a violet storm

entries.title: Caravan of the Lantern Marsh
entries.description: Travelers cross a bioluminescent wetland beside a colossal snail carrying a lantern shrine.

media.alt: Travelers crossing a luminous marsh beside a giant lantern-bearing snail

entries.title: Forge Below the Mountain
entries.description: An artisan and fire salamander shape a luminous relic while companions watch in an ancient underground forge.

media.alt: Fantasy artisan and fire salamander crafting a relic in an underground forge

entries.title: The Wyvern Keeper
entries.description: A desert keeper and celestial wyvern receive a guild expedition at an oasis observatory.

media.alt: Desert keeper and celestial wyvern greeting a guild expedition

entries.title: The Sunken Concord
entries.description: Guild envoys exchange a glowing crystal with aquatic guardians inside a submerged temple.

media.alt: Guild envoys meeting aquatic guardians inside a submerged fantasy temple

entries.title: Courier Above the Snow
entries.description: A colossal white owl carries guild satchels over a winter city as the streets look up.

media.alt: Colossal white owl carrying guild satchels above a snowy fantasy city

entries.title: The Clocktower Without Time
entries.description: Three adventurers enter a broken clocktower where spectral armor circles a shattered pendulum.

media.alt: Adventurers facing spectral armor inside a broken fantasy clocktower

entries.title: Shelter After the Storm
entries.description: A weary party tends an injured companion while a forest spirit shields their ruined roadside shrine.

media.alt: Fantasy party tending an injured companion beneath a ruined shrine

entries.title: Dawn Market in the High Boughs
entries.description: Human and nonhuman artisans trade maps, meals and charms across an ancient tree-city.

media.alt: Fantasy market populated by humans and creatures in the branches of a giant tree

entries.title: The Bone Colossus Wakes
entries.description: A canyon-born giant rises as a guild party evacuates travelers and forms a defensive line.

media.alt: Massive bone colossus rising above a canyon as adventurers defend travelers

entries.title: Road Beneath the Astral Whale
entries.description: A night caravan pauses beneath a star-whale crossing the sky above a distant mountain city.

media.alt: Night caravan beneath a glowing astral whale crossing a starry sky

entries.title: Tea in the Moon Garden
entries.description: Guild envoys share a quiet table with a forest guardian and curious young griffins after a long conflict.

media.alt: Guild envoys sharing tea with a forest guardian and young griffins in a moonlit garden
